newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian SGB takes GBL rep on.
newsitem.headline: Belgian SGB takes GBL rep on.

text.p: Belgian holding company SGB on Wednesday proposed Thierry de Rudder, a director of Belgian holding company Groupe Bruxelles Lambert SA (GBL) as a member of its board.
It will be the first time that SGB, the largest and oldest holding company in the country, has placed a representative of its main competitor on its board of directors.

"The issue of having a GBL representative on our board has been around for a long time as GBL controls about two percent of our capital and is thus our third most important shareholder," Chairman Etienne Davignon told shareholders.

Asked whether de Rudder's nomination was due to the fact that GBL had now become an important minority shareholder in SGB parent Compagnie de Suez, Davignon said: "That is not the reason, but it doesn't prevent it either."
SGB also proposed Christine Morin-Postel, a representative of Suez, as a member of the board.
